component.name: IR Transceiver
component.summary: Learn, capture and send infrared codes

description.p: IR Transceiver controls ELK Smart USB infrared blasters. It learns codes from remote controls, captures everything the dongle receives, shows the data as hex, binary, decimal, Base64 or pulse timings, recognises common remote protocols, keeps codes in a tagged library and sends them again.

ul.li: Live capture of received signals and of every USB transfer
Send learned codes, pulse timings, NEC codes or raw USB bytes
Import and export LIRC, Flipper Zero and Pronto codes
